UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Visual, reading, catalog, and accessibility preferences synced in the user's cloud account.

edgeRefraction.description: Whether optical edge refraction is enabled.

enableLensRefraction.description: Whether convex lens refraction is enabled.

backgroundExtension.description: Whether cover ambient lighting extension is enabled.

showBottomAccessory.description: Whether to show the active reading bar above the dock.

showFloatingMenu.description: Whether to show the top floating quick actions bar.

minimizeTabBarOnScroll.description: Whether to minimize the bottom dock when scrolling.

reduceTransparency.description: Accessibility toggle to reduce glass transparency.

increaseContrast.description: Accessibility toggle to increase border and text contrast.

onOffLabels.description: Accessibility toggle to show I/O labels on switches.

shelfColumns.description: Number of grid columns in the library shelf (2..4).

showProgressOnCovers.description: Whether to show reading progress overlays on covers.

showRatingsOnGrid.description: Whether to show star ratings on grid cards.

spine3dEffect.description: Whether to render 3D book spine effects on covers.

defaultShelfSort.description: Default sorting mode in the library.

shelfLayout.description: Selected layout mode in the library shelf.

defaultFormat.description: Default edition format when cataloging new comics.

hdCovers.description: Whether to prioritize high-definition cover images.

spoilerProtection.description: Whether to blur spoiler reviews in the diary.

halfStarRatings.description: Whether half-star ratings (0.5 increments) are enabled.

autoFillReadDate.description: Whether to auto-fill today's date when marking a comic as read.

showPagesInDiary.description: Whether to show page counts and publisher in diary entries.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Collector profile, avatar photo, reading goals, and app preferences synced in the cloud for an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

name.description: Display name of the reader (1..80 chars).

handle.description: Unique reader handle (@username, up to 60 chars).

normalizedHandle.description: Normalized lowercase username key without @ (2..60 chars).

bio.description: Short biography of the reader (up to 400 chars).

favoriteUniverse.description: Favorite comic publisher or universe (up to 80 chars).

avatarUrl.description: Profile photo URL or cropped base64 data URI synced to the user's account.

showGoalOnHome.description: Whether to show the reading goal progress on the Home screen.

activeReadingComicId.description: ID of the currently active reading comic in the bottom mini-bar.

preferences.description: Synced application preferences for the user.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UsernameReservation.title: UsernameReservation
UsernameReservation.description: Registry entry enforcing globally unique @username handles across all users.

ownerId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this username.

normalizedHandle.description: Lowercase normalized handle key matching the document ID.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the username was claimed or refreshed (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CloudComic.title: CloudComic
CloudComic.description: A comic book or graphic novel entry in the user's personal cloud library and reading diary.

ownerId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the comic owner.

status.description: Reading status in the user's shelf.

coverUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the comic cover.

synopsisPtBr.description: Translated PT-BR synopsis text (up to 5000 chars).

seriesName.description: Series name for chronological sequence grouping.

issueNumber.description: Issue or volume number within the series.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores authenticated user's profile, avatar photo, reading goals, and application preferences.

/users/{userId}/comics/{comicId}.description: Stores authenticated user's personal comic library and reading diary entries.

/usernames/{handleKey}.description: Enforces globally unique @username handles across accounts.
